title: THE SIGNAL GROWS
hero: mmx image-01 (Folana's cozy radio room, fairy lights, signal meters glowing, community gathered with letters and photos)
description: The Inner Circle continues to expand. Letters arrive under the door, voicemails stack up on the machine, melodies are hummed into the phone at 3 AM. Folana realizes her broadcast has become a collective — the signal is no longer a single thread but a tapestry woven by many hands. Community feedback shapes the broadcast, making the transmission stronger than ever before.
style: Indie folk / Dream pop with warm acoustic guitar fingerpicking, soft piano, gentle strings, delicate percussion, tender female vocals with layered harmonies. Building from intimate verses to a soaring, hopeful chorus. Key of G major with E minor shifts. Warm, building, hopeful.
